out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Modification to Section 4-205.10 Equipment Certification
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The following items are intended for household use only and are not approved for use in a commercial food establishment:Small Chest freezer, Large Chest Freezer, Ice Machine, Food Warmer at front service counter.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTIONS: Facility owner must replace all listed equipment with commercial units within 60 days. Food equipment that is certified or classified for sanitation by an American National Standards Institute (ANSI) accredited certification program will be deemed to comply with Parts 4-1 and 4-2 of this chapter. Food equipment in a food establishment shall be certified of classified by an ANSI-accredited certification program, an equivalent certification program, or approved by the Regulatory Authority before installation and/or use.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. No chlorine test kit at facility.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION Obtain a BLEACH test kit.Provided owner with some strips for present use.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Carpeting , Secure to Floor and Wall
violations.observation: OBSERVATION:Carpeting is not securely attached to the floor or installed under the coving.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Owner removed carpets during the inspection. If carpeting is installed as a floor covering, it shall be 1) securely attached to the floor with a durable mastic, by using a stretch and tack method, or by another method; and 2) Installed tightly against the wall under the coving, or installed away from the wall with a space between the carpet and the wall and with the edges of the carpet secured by metal stripping or some other means.
